title: Automorphisms of Kimura Hadamard Matrices
summary: We investigate the structure of the automorphism groups of Kimura Hadamard matrices (KHMs) constructed from dihedral groups. We identify several different types of automorphisms, and show that the automorphism group of a KHM always has a subgroup isomorphic to $D_{2k}\times Q_8$, or $C_2\times D_{2k}\times Q_8$ if it is $y$-invariant. We exhibit additional automorphisms arising from the holomorph of the dihedral group under suitable structural conditions.
